description: Accessible drag-and-drop reorder surface with keyboard reorder, optional single-pointer move controls, live announcements and cross-surface transfer

attributes.name: group
attributes.description: Transfer group; items move between surfaces sharing a group

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: "horizontal" switches keyboard reorder to Left/Right and drop maths to the inline axis; both follow the computed direction (RTL-aware)

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables dragging out, dropping in, keyboard reorder and move controls; reflected as aria-disabled and skipped as a transfer target

attributes.name: data-move-controls
attributes.description: Renders per-item Move buttons (up/down or inline start/end, plus Move to <adjacent surface> for grouped surfaces) — the single-pointer alternative to dragging (WCAG 2.5.7)

attributes.name: data-drag-over
attributes.description: Present while a dragged item from an accepted source hovers the surface

attributes.name: data-reorder-mode
attributes.description: Present while one of the surface's items is grabbed for keyboard reorder

events.name: drag-surface:reorder-start
events.description: A pointer drag or keyboard grab began

events.name: drag-surface:reorder
events.description: Items within this surface were reordered (pointer drag, keyboard drop or move control)
events.detail: { item: HTMLElement, itemId: string | undefined, oldIndex: number, newIndex: number, order: (string | undefined)[] }

events.name: drag-surface:transfer
events.description: An item moved to another surface in the same group; fired on the receiving surface
events.detail: { item: HTMLElement, itemId: string | undefined, fromSurface: DragSurface, toSurface: DragSurface, newIndex: number, fromOrder: (string | undefined)[], toOrder: (string | undefined)[] }

events.name: drag-surface:reorder-end
events.description: A pointer drag or keyboard grab ended (dropped, cancelled or abandoned); for pointer drags it fires on the source surface

properties.name: sortedOrder
properties.description: data-id of each draggable child in DOM order

properties.name: draggableChildren
properties.description: Direct children with draggable="true" (a new array on each read)

childAttributes.name: draggable
childAttributes.description: Native attribute; marks a direct child as a reorderable item (gets role=listitem and tabindex=0, including items added later)

childAttributes.name: data-id
childAttributes.description: Stable identifier reported in event details and sortedOrder

childAttributes.name: data-sort-order
childAttributes.description: 1-based position, rewritten by the component after each move

childAttributes.name: data-drag-handle
childAttributes.description: Only this element starts a pointer drag; a focusable button handle also accepts reorder keys and gets aria-pressed while grabbed

childAttributes.name: data-grabbed
childAttributes.description: Output: present while the item is grabbed for keyboard reorder (with aria-description="Grabbed" unless the item has its own)

childAttributes.name: data-dragging
childAttributes.description: Output: present on the item during a pointer drag

childAttributes.name: data-drop-target
childAttributes.description: Output: insertion indicator during a pointer drag (drawn on the block or inline edge, RTL-aware)

childAttributes.name: data-just-dropped
childAttributes.description: Output: briefly present after a drop or move to trigger the flash animation
